reviews.title: Very unhappy with the app
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with this app. I paid for the yearly subscription, but for about six months the app would not generate a logo for me at all. Paying for a full year and then being unable to use one of the main features for half of that time is extremely frustrating.

I expected the app to work consistently, especially after paying for an annual subscription. Unfortunately, my experience has not matched what I paid for, and I would not recommend subscribing unless these issues are fixed.

reviews.title: Canceling a subscription
reviews.text: How do you cancel a subscription? I didn’t even want it and accidentally hit one button and it charged me 100 bucks for the yearly subscription that I didn’t want. I tried the free trial and wanted to cancel it because I don’t like the app. Thanks.

reviews.title: What happened to CURVE functionality?
reviews.text: LOVED this app. Used it for years and created multiple ROUND logos for my business, none of which I can now edit because the CURVE functionality is no longer working for the text.  Deleted, reloaded.  Sent a message months ago and got NO RESPONSE. Fix that functionality and it would be five stars for me.

reviews.title: Pirates
reviews.text:
Dont trust this app. They advertise a 3 day Free trial and after charging $39.99 
They look my money same day the trial started. I cancelled my subscription and requested a refund. The Refund was Denied! I sent in an appeal. I hope to not get my Attorney involved and they refund my money. But I’ll need to do what I need to do. They Are Pirates!
